scope: Eight cold nonlinear equilibria with only the existing freeze_influences flag changed from false to true. Compare to exactly pinned current live-field states and the archived source at four selected conditions. This tests a documented ASWING K/F setting; the historical .set file is missing and its actual flag is not proven. No production/default/tolerance changes or fitted properties.

mesh_gates.scope: Numerical mesh change only; not historical or experimental acceptance.

fixed_observables: Earth sensor3 displacement relative to matched native gravity baseline
comparison.runtime_comparison: Descriptive; same host, independent cold solves.

failure_policy: Stop the affected mesh batch at its first failure, retain all failed results, do not retry. The other independent mesh may finish.

primary_evidence.user_guide: K/F screenshot shows T; Fast,Slow Vortex-Lattice Model defines jig geometry and zero alpha/beta. Screenshot does not establish archived executable defaults.
primary_evidence.missing_history: Invoking ASWING with basename can auto-load .set/.pnt/.con. Those Pazy companions are not archived.
